description: This PHP class defines a RefreshTokenEntity used in the OAuth2 implementation within the OrangeHRM project. It manages refresh token properties such as identifier, expiry date, and associated access token, implementing the necessary interface and utilizing traits for date handling and OAuth server functions.

classes.name: RefreshTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents a refresh token in the OAuth2 system, including properties for identifier, expiry date/time, and associated access token, with methods to get and set these properties.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the refresh token's unique identifier.

methods.name: setIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the refresh token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the expiry date and time of the refresh token.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date/time, overriding to ensure UTC and TTL.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Associates an access token entity with this refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Returns the associated access token entity.
